This is NOT the full 12,814-Act statute tree used by Bhattacharya et al. (2022) - that data is not published anywhere (PROJECT_NOTES.md section 3). Extend it with STATUTE_HIERARCHY_PATH (see SCALING.md). Any cited Act absent from this file still receives an Act-level node in Hier-SPCNet.
